item.title: District Receives Grant for PPE Extractor; Will Make Available to Other FDs
item.description: Lyon County (KS) Fire District No. 5 received a $5,000 grant to purchase an extractor for cleaning PPE, enhancing cancer risk reduction efforts and supporting neighboring fire departments. The post District Receives Grant for PPE Extractor; Will Make Available to Other FDs appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Green Bay (WI) Receives $5.5M in Federal Funding for New $19M Station
item.description: The new station will combine operations from two stations, housing firefighters operating out of Fire Station 3 as well as the department's leadership and administrative staff, which has temporarily moved from Station 1 to City Hall. The post Green Bay (WI) Receives $5.5M in Federal Funding for New $19M Station appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.description: San Diego (CA) Fire-Rescue built Station 52 to address regional growth and call volume, featuring electric vehicle infrastructure and future expansion. item.title: CT Town Tests Drones so Fire, Police Can Have ‘Eye in the Sky’
item.description: Middletown (CT) has entered into a 90-day trial with Flock Safety for a "First Responder" drone system that can reach police and fire emergencies quicker than first responders. item.title: Veteran Firefighter Drowns in Ice Tragedy at NJ Waterfront Marina
item.description: A veteran firefighter in South Jersey died after falling through ice at Wiggins Park Marina. He was submerged for several minutes before being pronounced dead at the hospital.
